source_title: An S3-compatible object store backed by iCloud Shared Photo Albums. Quota policy: Apple's Shared Album loophole. - GitHub
source_excerpt:
An S3-compatible object store backed by iCloud Shared Photo Albums. Quota policy: Apple's Shared Album loophole.
Apple gives every iCloud account 5 GB of free storage, then charges monthly for iCloud+. However, Apple's published iCloud Shared Albums policy states that photos and videos in Shared Albums do not count against your iCloud storage .
An Apple ID can create 200 Shared Albums , each holding 5,000 photos up to 2048×2048 pixels. A lossless 2048×2048 24-bit RGB PNG holds 12.18 MB of raw pixel data. That is up to 1,000,000 objects (~12 TB of raw capacity) stored at 0 bytes of iCloud Drive quota.
icloud-s3 is a Rust server that speaks the Amazon S3 XML REST protocol ( aws s3 , boto3 , rclone , s5cmd ) and stores every object inside the RGB pixels of lossless PNG carrier images in Shared Albums. Each image has a 64-pixel visual HUD banner burned into the top so your production database backups are readable when you scroll past them in Photos.app .
Satire. icloud-s3 is a joke, not affiliated with Apple or AWS, and not for production or sensitive data. A Memories slideshow set to acoustic guitar is not a 99.999999999% durability SLA.

Why encode bytes into pixels instead of EXIF or PNG tEXt chunks? Media pipelines strip ancillary metadata chunks on upload. If Apple changes a single pixel value, icloud-s3 catches it immediately via the embedded CRC32 and SHA-256 digests.

Buckets (Shared Albums) : ListBuckets ( GET / ), CreateBucket ( PUT /:bucket ), DeleteBucket ( DELETE /:bucket ), HeadBucket ( HEAD /:bucket )
Objects (RGB Carrier Frames) : PutObject ( PUT /:bucket/*key , including AWS SigV4 STREAMING-AWS4-HMAC-SHA256-PAYLOAD chunked uploads), GetObject ( GET /:bucket/*key ), HeadObject ( HEAD /:bucket/*key ), DeleteObject ( DELETE /:bucket/*key ), DeleteObjects ( POST /:bucket?delete )
Listing : ListObjects & ListObjectsV2 ( GET /:bucket?list-type=2&prefix=...&delimiter=...&max-keys=... )
Visual Inspection : icloud-s3 bench (live Terminal UI) and GET /:bucket/*key?format=png (raw 24-bit RGB carrier PNG)
Apple's published Shared Album limits state that Shared Albums do not count against iCloud storage, while enforcing activity and item limits:
Maximum Shared Albums per owner : 200 albums.
Maximum photos/videos per Shared Album : 5,000 items.
Maximum combined hourly / daily contributors & uploads : 1,000 photos per hour and 10,000 photos per day across Shared Albums.
Resolution limit : Photos in Shared Albums are limited to 2048 pixels on the long edge (up to 5449 pixels for panoramas). icloud-s3 keeps every generated PNG frame at or below 2048×2048 pixels.
Recompression risk : While PNGs imported locally or kept in album directories remain bit-exact, if Apple's server-side Shared Album pipeline transcodes an asset to lossy JPEG/HEIC on a downstream device, the least-significant bits of the RGB channels will change and icloud-s3 will fail closed with ChecksumMismatch .
An S3-compatible object store backed by iCloud Shared Photo Albums. Quota policy: Apple's Shared Album loophole.
